dynamickeycards.card_reader.reset_confir: Click again to wipe every registered card
dynamickeycards.link_device.wrench_picku: Sneak-click again to pick up the device
dynamickeycards.link_device.already_boun: That device is already connected to something else
dynamickeycards.link_device.needs_regist: You can only connect while the reader is in register mode
dynamickeycards.link_device.maintenance_: Needs the linked reader's owner, a golden maintenance card, or a matching estate maintenance card
dynamickeycards.sensor.range_edit_prompt: Ctrl+Scroll to resize, then click again to confirm
dynamickeycards.sensor.range_already_edi: Already being edited - bare-hand click it to reset
dynamickeycards.estate.confirm: Right-click again to bind this card to you
dynamickeycards.card_reader.member_not_r: Member access cards can't be registered
dynamickeycards.command.transfer.receive: %s transferred a card reader to you
dynamickeycards.command.transfer.not_rea: Look at the card reader you want to transfer
dynamickeycards.command.transfer.not_own: Only the reader's owner or an operator can transfer it
dynamickeycards.command.release.success: Card reader released - it is now neutral, and only golden cards can administer it
dynamickeycards.command.release.already: This card reader already has no owner
dynamickeycards.card_duplicator.blank_so: A blank card has nothing to duplicate
dynamickeycards.card_duplicator.member_s: Member access cards can't be duplicated
dynamickeycards.card_duplicator.manager_: Only a manager access card can be copied onto a blank manager card
dynamickeycards.card_duplicator.not_keyc: Only a keycard can be duplicated
dynamickeycards.tooltip.card_reader1: Binds to the player who places it.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.card_reader2: The owner can sneak-click to register cards.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.card_reader3: Registered cards trigger a short redstone signal.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.card_reader_wren: Its owner can sneak-click it twice with a wrench or a maintenance card to pick it up straight into their inventory.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.sensor_wrench_pi: Sneak-click it twice with a wrench or a maintenance card to pick it up straight into your inventory.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.sensor1: Detects living entities in its own cell and the one below.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.sensor2: Outputs a continuous redstone signal while something is detected, with a configurable release delay.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.advanced_sensor1: Right-click a card reader while holding this to bind it, then place it.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.advanced_sensor2: Any registered card a nearby player is carrying triggers the bound reader remotely.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.transmitter1: Broadcasts wirelessly to any receiver bound to it. No local redstone output of its own.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.transmitter2: Right-click with a wrench or a maintenance card to set its mode; sneak-click it twice to pick it up.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.transmitter3: Triggered by any redstone signal reaching it, or by pressing it directly in Mixed Mode.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.receiver1: Right-click a card reader, transmitter, or advanced sensor while holding this to bind it, then place it.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.receiver2: Outputs a real redstone signal (0-15) mirroring the bound device - Pulse or Toggle mode.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.card_duplicator1: Copies a keycard's key onto blank keycards.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.card_duplicator2: Sneak-click with the source card, then with a blank card.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.keycard: Register it on a card reader to key it. Once keyed it can be duplicated.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.blank_keycard: Register it on a card reader to turn it into a keycard, or duplicate a card onto it.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.crew_manager1: Registering it also applies to every member card it issued — they pass wherever this card is registered.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.crew_manager2: Duplicate it onto a blank card to issue members, or onto a blank manager card for a co-manager.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.crew_member1: Passes wherever the manager card that issued it is registered.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.crew_member2: Can't be registered or duplicated. Dye it to recycle it into a blank card.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.golden_keycard1: Operates any card reader, registered or not.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.golden_keycard2: Sneak-click to arm register mode; click again there to reset the reader.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.estate1: Right-click to bind it to you; then it works like a golden keycard, but only on readers you own.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.estate2: Stays valid if you hand it to someone else. Can't be duplicated.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.golden_maintenan: Opens the config UI of, or picks up, any card reader (or a reader-bound peripheral) regardless of ownership.
Doesn't grant registration/passage access - see the Golden Keycard for that.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.estate_maintenan: Right-click to bind it to you; then it works like a Golden Maintenance Card, but only on readers you own.
Stays valid if you hand it to someone else. Can't be duplicated.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.reader_only_mode: Only the local redstone signal - nothing is sent over Create's Redstone Link.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.sensor_only_mode: Only the local redstone signal - nothing is sent over Create's Redstone Link.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.link_only_mode1: Only sends the signal over Create's Redstone Link, using the two frequency slots above - the physical redstone wire stays off.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.simultaneous_mod: Sends the signal over both the physical redstone wire and Create's Redstone Link, using the two frequency slots above.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.pulse_mode1: Like a button: the output is on while the bound device's signal is on, and off once it stops - optionally held a little longer by the release delay. Signal strength (0-15) is passed through unchanged.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.toggle_mode1: Like a lever: each time the bound device's signal switches on, the output flips and stays there - one trigger turns it on, the next turns it off. The release delay has no effect in this mode.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.redstone_only_mo: Only a redstone signal reaching the transmitter can trigger a broadcast - pressing it by hand does nothing. The signal's strength (0-15) is passed through unchanged.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.mixed_mode1: Either a redstone signal reaching the transmitter or an empty-handed right-click can trigger a broadcast. A manual trigger lasts for the duration set here.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.bound_sensor_cen: Both this sensor's own signal and the bound reader trigger together, timed by this sensor's own release delay.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.bound_reader_onl: Only the bound reader triggers - this sensor's own local signal stays off.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.mute_mode1: Light only - it turns in silence.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.caution_mode1: A flat mechanical tone alongside the light, held unbroken for as long as it turns.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.emergency_mode1: A wail alongside the light, climbing and falling away once every two seconds. Carries twice as far as caution.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.bound_simultaneo: Both trigger, but independently - the reader releases on its own configured signal length instead of following this sensor.
dynamickeycards.jade.copy_pending: Copy pending — waiting for a blank card
dynamickeycards.tooltip.siren1: A rotating warning light. Spins while redstone reaches it, or while a device it was bound to is active.
dynamickeycards.tooltip.siren2: Right-click a card reader, transmitter, or advanced sensor while holding this to bind it - optional, it runs off plain redstone too.
